1409-5070-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Angelic Chorus trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

141-2438-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2438-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-2438-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

77-3899-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1746-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1746-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

277-1308-2557-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2034-7804--5.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
2034-7804--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-6633.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-6633.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1423-5932-6674.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
There are land cards in your library.
1423-5932-6674.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Rydia triggers, causing you to discard Golgari Grave-Troll, and then mill six cards and return Golgari Grave-Troll from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
If you milled one or more lands this way, Hedge Shredder triggers, putting them from your graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land(s) enter, Rydia triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to discard Golgari Grave-Troll, and then mill six cards and return Golgari Grave-Troll from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
Repeat from step 3 as able.

3054-5346-6797-6809.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Crime Novelist and Scion of Opulence trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

6798-6972-7726.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7640.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2173-5220-5332-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3258-7309-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Don & Leo. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
3258-7309-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1020-2034-2510-2866.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact or creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1020-2034-2510-2866.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

997-3991-4681.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4331-4993-5116-6289.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2604-3532-3949-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2604-3532-3949-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

625-1978-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
625-1978-3443.description:
Cause Deathbloom Ritualist to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1778-2173-5220.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Memnite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1477-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-4311-4423-5139.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Relic of Sauron.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

856-5631-5686-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3967-4484-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
3967-4484-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

202-4971-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
202-4971-6191.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Lich.
Repeat from step 2.

2092-4499-5421.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-4499-5421.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Redcap Thief.
When Redcap Thief enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

575-4319-4659-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-4319-4659-5441.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Granite Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

2034-3867-4231-5032-5184.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Cast Treats to Share from the top of your library by paying {G}, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens, and exiling Treats to Share.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Curious Pair from exile by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Curious Pair, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

698-805-4996.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is equal to or greater than half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
698-805-4996.description:
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling Beacon of Immortality into your library.
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn.
Cast Debt to the Deathless, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've gained this turn, but paying a total of {W}{W}{B}{B} due to Will's ability.
Resolve Debt to the Deathless, causing each opponent to lose twice X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
